name: PR FX
tagline: Command palette and shortcuts for Premiere Pro
about: Runs 375+ editing commands in Premiere Pro through the PR FX panel (CEP). The Edie UXP plugin is a demo only. Timeline-aware shortcuts and Ctrl+Space stay native; agents, Whisper and ffmpeg stay in Creative Assist.

install.after: On the next Premiere launch, open Window ▸ UXP Plugins ▸ Edie. CEP remains installed as the automatic migration fallback.
